a.aria-label: NCBIProtein:PNT94038.1 — catalyzes → MetaCyc:RXN-21730; subject experimental construct: CDQ83_11320, DSM5809 sequence; pET28b+ N-terminal His6/TEV construct, E. coli Rosetta. 2020 MS at55C, 5mM MgCl2/5mM PPi/1mM S7P; distinct kinetic assay at1mM PPi. TEV cleavage not demonstrated.; Evidence PMID:31871051: The Methods distinguish the pET28b+ and pD861-NT preparations, expression hosts, affinity purification and MS versus kinetic assay conditions. A tag is not proof of native assembly. (XPath /article/body/sec[5]/sec[3]/p[1] | /article/body/sec[5]/sec[3]/p[2] | /article/body/sec[5]/sec[6]/sec/sec[1]/p[2] | /article/body/sec[5]/sec[6]/sec/sec[2]/p[1] | /article/body/sec[5]/sec[7]/p[1] | /article/body/sec[5]/sec[7]/p[2]); Evidence NCBIProtein:PNT94038.1: The issuing GenBank record identifies accession PNT94038.1 with its source organism, locus and annotated product. The identity supports this endpoint, not independent proof of every catalytic or regulatory claim. (XPath /GBSet/GBSeq[GBSeq_accession-version='PNT94038.1']/GBSeq_feature-table | /GBSet/GBSeq[GBSeq_accession-version='PNT94038.1']/GBSeq_definition); Evidence PMID:31178853: The cloned thermosuccinogenes enzymes use a pET-28b-derived construct with an N-terminal His6 tag flanking a TEV protease site and E. coli Rosetta expression. This directly supports the CDQ83_11320 construct feature; tag cleavage is not documented. (XPath /article/body/sec[2]/sec[1]/p); Purified PPi-PFK converts S7P to SBP with PPi; minus-PPi/minus-enzyme controls distinguish product formation. F6P kinetics and rabbit aldolase coupling are separate observations.; Evidence: PMID:31871051, NCBIProtein:PNT94038.1

a.data-node-label: phosphofructokinase [Acetivibrio thermocellus ATCC 27405] [experimental construct: ATCC27405/DSM1237 Cthe_0347 pAHCT0347/pRSET-A, N-terminal His6, E. coli T7 Shuffle. Pfp-specific…]
a.aria-label: phosphofructokinase [Acetivibrio thermocellus ATCC 27405]; NCBIProtein:ABN51585.1; Declared type: protein; experimental construct: ATCC27405/DSM1237 Cthe_0347 pAHCT0347/pRSET-A, N-terminal His6, E. coli T7 Shuffle. Pfp-specific linker and codon-optimization details remain unresolved. The 2023 S7P-MS assay at50C is distinct from F6P competition/kinetics. No native homodimer measurement is inferred from sequence annotation.; Evidence PMID:37438781: Pfp pAHCT0347 carries an N-terminal His6 tag and is expressed in E. coli T7 Shuffle. The Pfp-specific passages do not establish a linker or codon optimization. Forward MS uses50C, 2mM PPi,2.115mM S7P,2.5mM MgCl2. The identity supports this endpoint, not independent proof of every catalytic or regulatory claim. (XPath /GBSet/GBSeq[GBSeq_accession-version='ABN51585.1']/GBSeq_feature-table | /GBSet/GBSeq[GBSeq_accession-version='ABN51585.1']/GBSeq_definition); Evidence hdl:1993/32279: The thesis identifies synthetic pAHCT0347 with a pRSET-A backbone, T7 Shuffle expression and His6-tagged Pfp purification. a.aria-label: 6-phosphofructokinase [Clostridium thermosuccinogenes]; NCBIProtein:PNT93300.1; Declared type: protein; experimental construct: CDQ83_07225 pET28b+/Rosetta His6/TEV construct; 55C F6P/ATP comparator. The 2020 assay used lyophilized rabbit aldolase/GPDH instead of ammonium-sulfate suspensions because S7P Ba-salt precipitated BaSO4; ammonium was added. The source NH4Cl2 formula is unresolved.; Evidence PMID:31178853: The CDQ83 proteins use pET28b N-terminal His6 constructs flanking a TEV site, Rosetta expression, heated CFE and55C donor assays; empty-vector controls are included, cleavage is not documented.
